fixtures.focus_summary: Demonstrates a chemistry-facing pilot campaign from literature consolidation through continuation planning.

belongs_in_method_template: phase structure for prior-art synthesis, falsifiable hypotheses, blinded analysis, and continuation planning
durable links to campaign phases, evidence packs, and continuation packets
outside_method_template: execution status for each corrosion run

phases.label: Question framing
phases.purpose: Define whether electrolyte additive X improves corrosion resistance enough to justify a larger battery-materials campaign.
required_inputs: operator boundary for acceptable corrosion rate change
completion_signals: the corrosion question can be falsified

input_linkages.purpose: Use the canonical campaign phase record as the lifecycle anchor.

output_linkages.purpose: Return framing completion through the campaign phase record.

phases.label: Prior knowledge consolidation
phases.purpose: Summarize published corrosion mechanisms, additive compatibility notes, and unresolved contradictions before pilot design.
completion_signals: prior art is linked instead of paraphrased from memory
contradictions remain explicit for design review

input_linkages.purpose: Read lifecycle status from the canonical campaign phase record.
Ground prior-art synthesis in durable evidence-pack references.

output_linkages.purpose: Record the completed synthesis through the campaign phase record.
Carry evidence references forward without embedding source bodies.

phases.label: Hypothesis registry
phases.purpose: Record the corrosion-reduction hypothesis and the null hypothesis for the additive screen.

input_linkages.purpose: Preserve lifecycle truth in the campaign phase record.
Tie hypothesis strength to the cited corrosion literature.

output_linkages.purpose: Expose registered hypotheses through the phase record.

hypotheses.statement: Additive X reduces corrosion current density compared with the baseline electrolyte under matched cycling conditions.
hypotheses.falsifiability_notes: Discard the claim if matched pilot cells show no separation outside measurement noise.
support_basis: two prior benchtop studies reported lower corrosion current
one internal screening note found similar passivation morphology
hypotheses.uncertainty_notes: Electrode preparation variance may still dominate apparent gains.
unresolved_questions: Does the effect hold after repeated thermal cycling?

phases.label: Experiment design
phases.purpose: Define a matched-cell pilot with explicit controls, sample counts, and microscopy handoff expectations.

input_linkages.purpose: Read the current phase status from the campaign record.
Carry prior-art evidence into the design rationale.

output_linkages.purpose: Publish design approval through the campaign phase record.

phases.label: Analysis plan
phases.purpose: Define how corrosion current, microscopy scoring, and ambiguity cases will be interpreted before results arrive.
completion_signals: the plan distinguishes support, failure, and inconclusive outcomes
analysis does not depend on unstated memory

input_linkages.purpose: Use the phase record as the analysis-plan lifecycle anchor.
Keep interpretation tied to the same evidence chain used in prior-art review.

output_linkages.purpose: Hand the analysis plan back through the campaign phase record.

phases.label: Adversarial review
phases.purpose: Stress the corrosion claim for hidden confounds before pilot execution is promoted.

input_linkages.purpose: Anchor review status to the same campaign phase record.
Tie challenge questions to explicit evidence references.

output_linkages.purpose: Return review obligations through the campaign phase record.

review.prompt: Try to falsify the additive-X corrosion improvement claim by looking for prep variance, thermal-history confounds, or microscopy scoring drift.
challenge_questions: Could electrode surface prep variance explain the lower apparent corrosion current?
What happens if microscopy scoring is blinded and re-run by a second reviewer?
review.residual_risk_notes: Proceed only if electrode prep is locked and microscopy scoring is blinded.

phases.label: Outcome documentation
phases.purpose: Record the pilot result, uncertainty, and failure boundary without inflating beyond the pilot evidence.

input_linkages.purpose: Read canonical lifecycle state from the campaign phase record.
Point back to the supporting pilot evidence packs.

output_linkages.purpose: Write the terminal phase outcome back through the campaign phase record.
Expose the evidence chain for the outcome summary.

outcome_record.summary: The pilot suggests lower corrosion current with additive X, but the confidence interval still overlaps the matched baseline runs.
outcome_record.uncertainty_notes: The microscopy readout agreed with the electrochemistry trend, but sample count remains too small for promotion beyond a working claim.
unresolved_questions: Does the signal persist after a larger thermal-cycling matrix?
failure_notes: The pilot did not yet justify promotion to a strong claim.

phases.label: Continuation
phases.purpose: Define the next-step handoff without embedding the continuation packet payload.
completion_signals: future work has an explicit next decision

input_linkages.purpose: Start continuation planning from the canonical phase record.
Carry forward the pilot evidence by durable reference.

output_linkages.purpose: Return continuation status through the campaign phase record.
Expose successor handoff through a continuation packet link.

continuation_notes.next_decision: Run a larger blinded thermal-cycling matrix before promoting additive X beyond a working claim.
continuation_notes.handoff_summary: Carry forward the overlapping confidence interval, microscopy agreement, and the need for blinded prep logs.
stop_conditions: Stop if the larger matrix still overlaps the baseline within measurement noise.
Stop if blinded prep logging cannot be enforced for the follow-up matrix.

fixtures.focus_summary: Demonstrates a fabrication-facing pilot campaign using the same method template from evidence-linked prior knowledge through continuation.

belongs_in_method_template: phase structure for diagnosing drift causes with explicit evidence and continuation handoff
cross-domain method obligations that remain neutral to the fabrication stack

phases.label: Question framing
phases.purpose: Define whether the recent alignment drift is caused by fixture slippage, calibration decay, or thermal expansion.

input_linkages.purpose: Anchor triage framing to the campaign phase record.

output_linkages.purpose: Return framing completion through the campaign phase record.

phases.label: Prior knowledge consolidation
phases.purpose: Summarize prior drift incidents, calibration procedures, and thermal-load notes before new tests are designed.
completion_signals: history is linked instead of retold

input_linkages.purpose: Read lifecycle context from the canonical campaign phase record.
Tie the prior-incident summary to durable telemetry and maintenance evidence packs.

output_linkages.purpose: Expose the synthesis through the campaign phase record.
Carry forward cited telemetry and maintenance evidence.

phases.label: Hypothesis registry
phases.purpose: Record candidate causes for the alignment drift and the evidence behind each.

input_linkages.purpose: Use the phase record as the lifecycle anchor.
Ground drift hypotheses in telemetry and maintenance evidence packs.

output_linkages.purpose: Expose registered hypotheses through the campaign phase record.

hypotheses.statement: Fixture slippage during thermal cycling caused the observed alignment drift.
hypotheses.falsifiability_notes: Reject if instrumented repeat runs show the drift without any clamp displacement.
support_basis: two incidents followed higher-than-usual fixture temperature
hypotheses.uncertainty_notes: Calibration decay could still explain the same pattern.
unresolved_questions: Did the clamp torque remain inside spec during both incidents?

phases.label: Experiment design
phases.purpose: Define a constrained repeat-run matrix with clamp-torque monitoring and calibration checks.
completion_signals: measurements can separate the leading causes

input_linkages.purpose: Use the campaign phase record as the design handoff anchor.
Carry prior telemetry evidence into the repeat-run design.

output_linkages.purpose: Return design readiness through the campaign phase record.

phases.label: Analysis plan
phases.purpose: Define how torque drift, thermal expansion, and calibration offsets will be compared before narrative conclusions are written.
completion_signals: success and failure criteria are explicit

input_linkages.purpose: Anchor analysis planning to the canonical campaign phase record.
Keep planned comparisons tied to telemetry evidence packs.

output_linkages.purpose: Return the analysis plan through the campaign phase record.

phases.label: Adversarial review
phases.purpose: Challenge the leading drift explanation before scarce machine time is consumed.

input_linkages.purpose: Preserve review lifecycle truth in the campaign phase record.
Tie the challenge list to the same telemetry evidence chain.

output_linkages.purpose: Publish review obligations through the campaign phase record.

review.prompt: Try to falsify the fixture-slippage explanation before booking more machine time.
challenge_questions: Could encoder calibration drift alone generate the same pattern even with stable clamp torque?
What measurement would cleanly separate thermal expansion from fixture slippage?
review.residual_risk_notes: Proceed only if repeat runs log clamp torque and calibration offsets in the same evidence pack.

phases.label: Outcome documentation
phases.purpose: Record what the pilot triage actually learned without pretending it solved the full drift problem.

input_linkages.purpose: Read lifecycle status from the campaign phase record.
Point back to telemetry and maintenance evidence by reference.

output_linkages.purpose: Write the triage outcome through the campaign phase record.
Carry outcome evidence into closeout and follow-up review.

outcome_record.summary: The pilot supports fixture slippage as the leading cause, but encoder calibration decay remains a live secondary explanation.
outcome_record.uncertainty_notes: The repeat-run matrix was small and only one thermal profile was sampled.
unresolved_questions: Does the same drift pattern persist after a fresh encoder calibration?
failure_notes: The pilot triage narrowed causes but did not yet eliminate calibration decay.

phases.label: Continuation
phases.purpose: Prepare the next-step handoff for the drift investigation without embedding continuation payload state.

input_linkages.purpose: Start continuation planning from the canonical phase record.
Carry forward the pilot telemetry evidence by reference.

output_linkages.purpose: Return continuation state through the campaign phase record.
Hand successor work a continuation packet link rather than an embedded payload.

continuation_notes.next_decision: Run one calibration-refresh control before scheduling any larger fixture redesign campaign.
continuation_notes.handoff_summary: Carry forward the fixture-slippage evidence, the live calibration-decay caveat, and the requirement for shared torque-plus-calibration logging.
stop_conditions: Stop if the calibration-refresh control removes the drift signal entirely.
Stop if the combined torque and calibration logging cannot be captured durably.
